newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian bonds shrug off new party scandal.
newsitem.headline: Belgian bonds shrug off new party scandal.

text.p: Belgian linear bonds ended Tuesday with slight gains, shrugging off the latest bribery scandal to hit the country's Francophone Socialist Party, but the future direction remains unclear.
The scandal did hit the Belgian franc, although traders said the government did not appear to be seriously threatened.
The benchmark 2007 OLO ended the day yielding 5.82 percent, and the spread over German Bunds widened to six basis points having at one stage hit a new low of just one basis point.
The March futures contract was 11 basis points higher at 121.50 in a 121.55/120.98 range.
